notes.title: Hotfix Notes for August 22
notes.content:
New content:
- New enemy variations
- Dialogs have been visually improved 
- Overall visual improvement of the game
- Talent tree has been improved regarding UI/UX

Bug fixes:
- Fix some enemies that were sometimes unable to move
- Fix various Achievements that were impossible to unlock
- Fix some enemies attacks that may not hit the player
- Fix various Hexium Board elements that didn't work as expected
- Fix various items that did not work as expected
- Fix empty rooms that were softlocking players
- Fix room's colliders
